findings.title: Outgoing-only joint voter rejects a valid recovery snapshot
findings.cause: The live restore membership guard omits VotersOutgoing and LearnersNext.
findings.impact: A required outgoing voter can remain unable to catch up after compaction and block joint-quorum progress.
